name: dilated
title: Dilated
description: Start and stop Dilated keep-awake sessions
author: scttbnsn

commands.name: start
commands.title: Start Awake Session
commands.subtitle: Dilated
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake until stopped; respects paused automation

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop All Awake Sessions
commands.subtitle: Dilated
commands.description: Stop every Dilated hold and pause automation

commands.name: status
commands.title: Show Awake Status
commands.subtitle: Dilated
commands.description: Show active holds and whether automation is paused

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Dilated CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to use ~/.local/bin/dilated installed from Dilated Settings
